intro: On your turn (clockwise from Agekeeper), take any actions below in any order, as many times as you like. Activating Crucible Cards (Light Cauldrons) is an Autumn action — see Phase 3: Autumn.

children.label: 🏰 Build Astral House
children.body: Pay Planet-matching Kismeta Cards; place an Astral House token on a Zodiac Sign. Each House is a permanent Alignment source for every future Harvest. Tip: Houses built early pay off every Spring Harvest for the rest of the game — a late-game House barely earns back its cost.

children.label: ⚒️ Craft Reagent
children.body: Confirm the matching Cauldron is lit, then discard 3 cards of the matching Suit from your Spread and/or Hand. Take 1 Reagent token from the supply. Salt: Discard any 3 cards — no Cauldron needed. Tip: Craft from your Hand when you can — it preserves the card sets and Alignments sitting in your Spread.

children.label: 🤝 Trade
children.body: Freely exchange Kismeta Cards, Reagents, or Active Crucible Cards with any rival. Trading is the only way to transfer Reagents and Active Crucible Cards between players.

gameModeNote.magnus: Misaligned players trade 2:1 in favor of the non-initiating player.

children.label: 🤺 Duel
children.body: Wager a card from your Spread; roll dice against a rival — winner steals the targeted card from the Defender's Spread.

children.label: 🎲 Gambit
children.body: Name a rival's Active Crucible Card (Crucible Gambit) or Adept card (Arcanum Gambit) as your target, and declare one of your own as your stake; pay any Ward entry fee; roll dice — a Challenger win swaps the two cards, a Challenger loss Arrests your offered card (pay 1 Salt on a future Summer turn to free it).
